dinners.name: Sheet Pan Greek Lemon Chicken with Tomatoes, Peppers, Olives, Feta & Tzatziki
dinners.blurb: THE DEAL: Publix boneless skinless chicken breasts, BOGO FREE. Garlicky lemon-oregano chicken roasted hot, with blistered tomatoes, red onion and peppers, salty olives and feta, cool tzatziki and brown rice.
dinners.total: 1 hr 45 min (tzatziki chill, marinade, rice and oven are hands-off)
dinners.warn: COOK ONCE, EAT TWICE: roast about 4 lb of chicken and all 3 cups of rice. The plain 1.5-lb pan and half the rice are Wednesday's fried rice. Start around 4:15. TONIGHT: move the frozen shrimp to the fridge for Tuesday.
dinners.alt: Sheet pan Greek chicken breasts with roasted cherry tomatoes, red onion, olives and feta

items: About 4 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts (2.5 lb tonight, 1.5 lb for Wednesday)
2 large red onions, cut into 1/2-inch slices
2 of the 3 tricolor peppers, cut into 1-inch pieces
Hot sauce or pepper flakes at the table
1 hot house cucumber, grated and squeezed dry
2 tsp lemon juice (from the marinade lemons)
2 Tbsp sliced scallion greens (the recipe's chives)
3 cups dry brown rice (about 9 cups cooked; about 5 cups are Wednesday's)

directions: About 4:15, make the tzatziki: grate the cucumber, salt it, drain it and squeeze it dry. Stir in the yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, dill, scallion greens, salt and pepper. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

Pound the chicken to an even 1/2 inch under plastic wrap. Whisk the oil, garlic, lemon zest and juice, thyme, oregano, salt and pepper. Set aside 1/2 cup for the vegetables, pour the rest over the chicken and coat it. Marinate 30 min at room temperature (or refrigerate up to 2 hours). Cut the vegetables while it sits.
Start ALL 3 cups of brown rice, about 45 min hands-off.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Line THREE rimmed sheet pans with parchment.
WEDNESDAY'S PAN: put 1.5 lb of the chicken alone on one pan, pieces not touching. Roast 15-20 min, until it reaches 165°F. Set it aside to cool.
Toss the tomatoes, onions and peppers with the reserved marinade, spread them on the second pan and roast 10 min.

Put the remaining 2.5 lb of chicken on the third pan, pieces not touching, and add it to the oven. Roast 15-20 min, swapping racks halfway, until the thickest part reaches 160°F. Move the chicken to a plate, cover and rest 5 min.

Scatter the olives over the vegetables and keep roasting while the chicken rests. Pile the chicken and vegetables on a platter or back on the pan, then top with the feta and parsley. Serve with rice, tzatziki and heat on the side.
Before bed: refrigerate Wednesday's cooled chicken whole in a covered container. Spread about 5 cups of the rice on a sheet pan to cool quickly, then refrigerate it within an hour.
ALSO BEFORE BED: move the shrimp from the freezer to the fridge so it thaws for Tuesday.
dinners.reuse: Hands Wednesday 1.5 lb of cooked chicken and about 5 cups of rice. Shares peppers and scallions with Wed, lemons and parsley with Tue/Thu, and cucumbers with Thu.

dinners.name: Garlic Shrimp Linguine with Broccoli, Spinach & Lemon
dinners.blurb: THE DEAL: Publix peeled & deveined white shrimp, 24 oz, $13.49 (about $9/lb), with the 2-lb broccoli bag at $6.99. Whole-wheat linguine tossed with garlicky shrimp, plenty of vegetables, white wine, lemon and Parmesan.
dinners.warn: Needs the shrimp thawed: move it to the fridge Monday night. Use your widest pot, because this is a lot of food. Save the rest of the broccoli for Wednesday.
dinners.alt: Whole-wheat garlic shrimp pasta with lemon and vegetables in a skillet

items: 24 oz peeled & deveined medium white shrimp, thawed
About 1 1/4 lb broccoli florets, cut small
1/3 cup dry white wine or low-sodium chicken broth
Zest and juice of 2 large lemons
1/3 cup freshly grated Parmesan, plus more for serving
3 Tbsp chopped parsley, plus more for serving
Red pepper flakes at the table

directions: Boil the linguine in well-salted water until al dente. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water, drain, and toss the pasta with a little olive oil.
Pat the thawed shrimp very dry. Heat 1 1/2 Tbsp oil in a wide pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Cook the shallots about 2 min, then the garlic 1 min.
Season the shrimp with 3/4 tsp salt and 3/4 tsp pepper. Cook in 2 batches, 2-3 min per batch, until pink and opaque. Move the shrimp, shallots and garlic to a plate.
Heat the remaining 1 1/2 Tbsp oil. Add the broccoli, 3/4 tsp salt, 3/4 tsp pepper and a splash of water. Cook 4-5 min, until crisp-tender. Fold in the spinach and cook 1 min, until wilted.
Add the wine and return the shrimp to the pot. Cook 2 min to reduce the wine. Stir in the lemon zest and juice and take the pot off the heat.
Add the pasta, Parmesan and parsley and toss, loosening with pasta water if it seems dry. Taste for salt and lemon. Serve with more Parmesan and pepper flakes at the table.
dinners.reuse: Starts the broccoli bag (rest goes to Wed) and the spinach (rest goes to Thu). Shares lemons and parsley with Mon/Thu, Parmesan with Thu, garlic with Mon/Wed.

dinners.name: Chicken Fried Rice with Broccoli, Peppers & Scallions
dinners.blurb: THE DEAL: Monday's BOGO chicken, so there's no new protein to buy, plus the rest of the $6.99 broccoli. Savory fried rice with oyster sauce, soy, garlic, lots of vegetables and soft scrambled egg. It doesn't taste like Monday at all.
dinners.warn: No raw meat tonight: uses Monday's 1.5 lb of plain roasted chicken and about 5 cups of Monday's cold rice.
dinners.alt: Chicken fried rice with egg, vegetables and scallions in a skillet

ingredients.group: Recipe scaled 1.5x; fresh vegetables replace the frozen bag
items: About 5 cups Monday's cold brown rice, broken up
3 Tbsp low-sodium soy sauce, plus more to taste
The rest of the broccoli (about 12 oz), cut small
8 oz baby cut carrots, diced small

directions: Mix the oyster sauce and soy sauce in a small bowl. Dice the chicken and chop all the vegetables. Keep a large bowl by the stove.
Heat your largest nonstick skillet or wok over medium heat for 2 min. Melt 1 tsp of the butter, add the eggs, and scramble into small pieces until just done. Move to the bowl and wipe out the pan.
Turn the heat to high. Add the oil, then the carrots, and cook 2 min. Add the broccoli and pepper and cook 4-5 min, until crisp-tender.
Add the remaining butter and the garlic. Stir about 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the cold rice and the sauce. Stir constantly, breaking up clumps, about 2 min. If the pan is overflowing, work in 2 batches.
Add the chicken, eggs and scallions and cook about 2 min, until the chicken is steaming hot. Taste for soy. Serve with hot sauce at the table.
dinners.reuse: Built on Monday's chicken and rice. Finishes the broccoli, peppers and scallions, and uses half the carrots (rest goes to Thu).

dinners.name: Skillet Sirloin with Onions & Mushrooms, Roasted Gold Potatoes & Spinach Salad
dinners.blurb: THE DEAL: Publix boneless top sirloin $8.99/lb, the best-value steak in the ad, with sliced mushrooms 2/$6 and the 5-lb gold potatoes at $4.99. Thin-sliced steak seared fast with browned onions and mushrooms, crispy potatoes and carrots, and a sharp lemon-Parmesan spinach salad.
dinners.warn: Bought Sunday, the sirloin should last to Thursday. Check the date, and if it won't, freeze it Sunday and thaw it in the fridge Wednesday.
dinners.alt: Thin-sliced skillet steak with browned onions and mushrooms

ingredients.group: Steak (recipe scaled up; the original is a light 1/2-lb sandwich filling)
items: 2 lb top sirloin, sliced into thin strips against the grain
2 tsp kosher salt, plus more for the vegetables
2 large yellow onions, sliced into rings
2 Tbsp olive oil, plus a little for each batch
Juice of 1/2 lemon + a handful of chopped parsley

ingredients.group: Potatoes & carrots (side added to the recipe)
items: 3 lb gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces
8 oz baby cut carrots, halved lengthwise

ingredients.group: Spinach salad (side added to the recipe)
items: Juice of 1/2 lemon + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt

directions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes and carrots with the oil, salt and pepper and spread over 2 sheet pans. Roast about 40 min, flipping and swapping racks halfway, until browned and crisp.
Slice the steak, then season it with the garlic powder, salt and pepper. Slice the onions. Do all this before the pan goes on, because the cooking goes fast.

Heat a large skillet over high heat until very hot. Add a little oil. Sear the beef in 4 batches, about 1 min on the first side and 30 seconds on the second. Move each batch to a large dish, and add oil between batches. Crowding steams the beef, so don't skip the batches.
Add a little oil and the onions, season with salt and pepper, and cook about 5 min, until golden. Add them to the beef.
Lower the heat to medium. Add the butter and remaining oil, then the mushrooms in 2 batches with salt and pepper. Cook until browned, 6-8 min total.
Return the beef, onions and juices to the skillet and stir to warm them through, about 1 min. Finish with the lemon juice and parsley.
Just before serving, toss the spinach and cucumber with the lemon juice, oil and salt. Top with Parmesan. Put hot sauce on the table.
dinners.reuse: Finishes the spinach, cucumbers, carrots, parsley, lemons and Parmesan. About 2 lb of gold potatoes is left in the bag and keeps well.
